policy: Exact computed metrics including paint after explicit resource-root mapping. Exact raster outside two measured native lab metadata controls (theme selector/profile status); no Ext component regions excluded, no pixel tolerance. Raw rasters and raw diffs preserved.

selectors: #lab-status text range: theme name and following date only
metadataRects.policy: Only native lab metadata outside the Ext fixture; status prefix and every other pixel remain compared. Rects measured with DOM Range for each case/state in both profile labels. Raw images are never edited.
